recipe.title: Vibrant Vegan Palak Paneer
recipe.description: A luxury plant-based take on the classic Indian favorite. Golden seared artisan vegan paneer cubes simmered in a velvet-smooth, aromatic garlic-spinach gravy enriched with silky cashew cream.

ingredients.item: Raw cashews (soaked in hot water for 15 mins)

instructions.text: Blanch the spinach in a pot of boiling salted water for 2 minutes. Transfer immediately to an ice water bath to preserve the brilliant green color. Drain well and blend with the green chili until completely smooth.
Blend the soaked cashews with 3 tablespoons of warm water in a high-speed blender until perfectly creamy.

Cut the pressed vegan paneer into 3/4-inch cubes. Heat 1/2 tablespoon of oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Pan-sear the paneer cubes for 4-5 minutes, turning occasionally until light golden brown on all sides. Remove and set aside.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in the skillet. Add cumin seeds and allow them to crackle for 30 seconds.
Add finely diced onion and sauté for 5-6 minutes until translucent and light brown. Add minced garlic and grated ginger, sautéing for another minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato puree, ground coriander, turmeric, and salt. Cook for 3-4 minutes until the tomatoes soften and oil begins to separate slightly from the masala base.
Pour in the pureed spinach along with 3 tablespoons of water. Mix well and let it simmer gently on low heat for 4 minutes.
Fold in the cashew cream, seared vegan paneer cubes, garam masala, and crushed kasoori methi. Simmer together for 2 minutes to let the flavors infuse.
Remove from heat, stir in fresh lemon juice, adjust seasoning if necessary, and serve immediately with garlic naan or basmati rice.

tips: Press the vegan paneer firmly between cloth or paper towels for at least 15 minutes prior to cooking to achieve the perfect bite and prevent splattering.
Do not overcook the spinach puree after adding it to the skillet; keeping cook time short preserves its brilliant green hue and fresh flavor.
